recipe.title: Pork loin stir-fry with broccoli and carrot over rice
steps: Cook the rice in water, let it cool and store it in 3 portions.
Slice the pork loin thin. Cut the broccoli into small florets and the carrot into thin sticks.
Heat the oil in a large pan. Stir-fry the pork 4 to 5 minutes until cooked, then take it out.
Stir-fry the carrot 3 minutes, add the broccoli and garlic and cook 3 more minutes.
Return the pork, add the soy sauce and ginger, and cook 1 minute.
Fill 3 boxes with rice, pork and vegetables. Keep in the fridge up to 3 days and reheat in the microwave.
